已实际联网检索，找到 IANA 官方页面和 RFC Editor 官方标准文档。两条来源均可正常访问。

1. **IANA Example Domains（官方说明）**

   IANA 明确说明，`example.com`、`example.org` 等域名专门用于文档和示例，可以无需事先协调而使用，并且不能被普通注册或转让。[IANA, Example Domains](https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains)。<Cite refs={["samplesearch0"]}/>

   完整 HTTPS 来源：https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains

2. **RFC 2606 — Reserved Top Level DNS Names（正式 RFC 标准）**

   RFC 2606 于 1999 年 6 月发布，第 3 节明确保留了 `example.com`、`example.net` 和 `example.org`，供文档示例使用。[RFC 2606, Section 3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc2606/)。<Cite refs={["samplesearch2"]}/>

   完整 HTTPS 来源：https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc2606/

**检索结论：** 两个来源均已通过联网搜索找到，且都是权威的一手来源：第一个来自 IANA，第二个来自 RFC Editor。不是根据模型记忆提供的链接。

下面分别绘制两组原生图表，并提供一个可以调整数量的交互示例。

## 1. 折线图：甲、乙周一至周三的数据

<Chart content={{"chartType":"line","meta":{"title":"甲与乙的数据变化","description":"周一至周三"},"xKey":"day","series":[{"dataKey":"jia","label":"甲"},{"dataKey":"yi","label":"乙"}],"data":[{"day":"周一","jia":1,"yi":3},{"day":"周二","jia":2,"yi":2},{"day":"周三","jia":3,"yi":1}]}}/>

## 2. 饼图：水果数量占比

<Chart content={{"chartType":"pie","meta":{"title":"水果数量分布"},"nameKey":"fruit","valueKey":"count","series":[{"dataKey":"count","label":"数量","valueSuffix":"个"}],"data":[{"fruit":"苹果","count":2},{"fruit":"梨","count":3},{"fruit":"香蕉","count":5}]}}/>

## 3. 交互示例：调整水果数量

可以修改每种水果的数量，饼图会同步更新。

{@body const [apple,setApple] = DIL.useState(2)}
{@body const [pear,setPear] = DIL.useState(3)}
{@body const [banana,setBanana] = DIL.useState(5)}
{@body const total = apple+pear+banana}
<box border radius="2xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  **调整水果数量**
  {#each [{name:"苹果",value:apple,set:setApple},{name:"梨",value:pear,set:setPear},{name:"香蕉",value:banana,set:setBanana}] as item}
    <box gap={1}>
      <row align="center" justify="between">
        **{item.name}**
        <title size="lg" color="default" tabularNums>{item.value}</title>
      </row>
      <row align="center" gap={2}>
        <button size="sm" color="secondary" variant="outline" disabled={item.value===0} onClick={()=>item.set(Math.max(0,item.value-1))}><icon name="minus"/></button>
        <box flex="1">
          <slider min={0} max={20} step={1} value={item.value} onChange={item.set}/>
        </box>
        <button size="sm" color="secondary" variant="outline" disabled={item.value===20} onClick={()=>item.set(Math.min(20,item.value+1))}><icon name="plus"/></button>
      </row>
    </box>
  {/each}
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  **实时饼图**
  {#if total>0}
    <Chart content={{"chartType":"pie","meta":{"title":"当前水果数量占比"},"nameKey":"fruit","valueKey":"count","series":[{"dataKey":"count","label":"数量","valueSuffix":"个"}],"data":[{"fruit":"苹果","count":apple},{"fruit":"梨","count":pear},{"fruit":"香蕉","count":banana}]}}/>
  {:else}
    <box padding={4} align="center">
      <text color="secondary">所有数量均为 0，暂无饼图数据。</text>
    </box>
  {/if}
  <row justify="between">
    <text color="secondary" size="sm">水果总数</text>
    **{total} 个**
  </row>
  <button block color="secondary" variant="outline" onClick={()=>{setApple(2);setPear(3);setBanana(5)}}><icon name="rotate-ccw" size="xs"/> 恢复初始数据</button>
</box>

以上包含两张独立的原生图表，以及一个可实时调整数量的交互饼图。

  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <button block onClick={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn("我的旅行偏好：\n感兴趣的地点："+([museum?"博物馆":null,park?"公园":null].filter(Boolean).join("、")||"未选择")+"\n偏好的季节："+season)}>确认并发送</button>
</box>
